subject: Laptop fans loud since last update
description: VeloSyncService.exe at 45 percent CPU all day. Library is about 180k files.
resolution: Updated to 4.1.3. CPU returned to normal.

subject: VPN fails from hotel
description: Error VG-619 at hotel Wi-Fi, works at home.
resolution: Set Protocol to TLS 443 in Connection settings.

subject: Asked for a 48 digit key after BIOS update
description: Screen asks for BitLocker recovery key. Work laptop.
resolution: Customer's IT admin provided the key from their device management portal. Advised suspending BitLocker before future BIOS updates.

subject: New phone, no codes
description: Replaced phone and cannot complete MFA. Personal account. Recovery codes lost.
resolution: Identity check completed in 2 business days, then MFA reset.

subject: One folder never finishes syncing
description: Status always says 1 file remaining. Activity shows VS-1042.
resolution: Enabled long path support in Advanced settings.

subject: Wi-Fi disconnects in office
description: Laptop drops off the 6 GHz office network every five minutes.

subject: All files renamed with a strange extension
description: Thousands of files changed overnight to .lockd. Suspected ransomware on one device.
resolution: Sync paused on all devices. Library rollback performed by support after account owner approval.

subject: Getting approval prompts I did not request
description: Phone showing many MFA prompts at night, then ID-429.
resolution: Password reset, sessions revoked, security team notified. Password had been reused on another site.

subject: Battery empty after a weekend asleep
description: Lid closed at 90 percent on Friday, dead by Monday.
resolution: BIOS update to 1.18 resolved standby drain.

subject: Connected but intranet does not open
description: VPN connected, public sites fine, internal wiki fails. New Wi-Fi 7 laptop. Error VG-2100.
resolution: Updated to 6.2.1 which fixes split DNS on Wi-Fi 7 adapters.

subject: Touchpad pushed up, case not closing flat
description: Laptop base seems bulged around the touchpad.
resolution: Treated as swollen battery. Customer told to stop use and not to charge. Replacement shipped under warranty.

subject: Battery stuck at 80 percent
description: Laptop plugged in overnight but never gets past 80 percent.
resolution: Battery Care mode was on. Explained behaviour and how to disable it.

subject: Large pages hang on VPN
description: Small pages load but file downloads stall over the tunnel.

subject: Locked out of my account
description: Mistyped the password several times, ID-423.
resolution: Password reset cleared the lock immediately.

subject: Online-only files take ages to open
description: Since upgrading to macOS 26, opening online-only documents takes 20 seconds or more.
